sources.title: jersobh/epochdb-extractor-0.8b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a high-speed, deterministic entity extraction, typed relation parsing, and query routing engine fine-tuned specifically for EpochDB. Built on top of unsloth/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base utilizing a hybrid Gated DeltaNet architecture, it delivers sub-millisecond structural parsing with zero Chain-of-Thought token bloat.
